title: THE ROLE OF HISTORICAL MEMORY IN SOCIETAL STABILITY AND CULTURAL REVIVAL
description: This article explores the role of historical memory in societal stability and cultural revival. Historical memory is considered a crucial factor in the formation of cultural heritage and national identity. The study analyzes how historical events are reflected in public consciousness and their impact on social stability and cultural awakening. Furthermore, it highlights the role of intergenerational transmission of knowledge and values through historical memory and its contribution to strengthening social awareness.
